title: PR 44035 Perps size denomination toggle review
description: Validate the single Perps size input, USD/BTC denomination toggle, conversions, percent input behavior, and in-session market persistence.
pre_conditions: Wallet fixture is onboarded/unlocked and the extension home.html target is reachable over CDP.
BTC Perps market route is available in the current extension build.
The order-entry form renders a positive BTC market price.

setup-status.intent: Read runner status before size input validation

setup-wallet-state.intent: Read wallet state before navigating to Perps order entry

setup-open-btc-market.intent: Open the BTC Perps trade order-entry surface

setup-wait-size-input.intent: Wait for the single size input to render

setup-scroll-size-input.intent: Bring the size input into view for screenshot evidence

ac1-assert-usd-default.intent: Assert the Size field is a single USD input with swap toggle

ac1-screenshot-usd-default.intent: Capture the default single Size input with USD unit and swap icon

ac2-enter-usd-size.intent: Enter a USD size before switching to the asset denomination

ac2-toggle-to-asset.intent: Tap the swap icon to switch the size input to BTC

ac2-assert-asset-unit.intent: Assert the input switched to BTC and displays the live-price equivalent

ac2-screenshot-asset-unit.intent: Capture the size input after switching to the BTC denomination

ac3-assert-equivalent-asset.intent: Assert the displayed BTC value is equivalent to the entered USD size

ac4-toggle-back-usd.intent: Tap the swap icon again to switch back to USD

ac4-assert-usd-return.intent: Assert the input returns to USD with the equivalent USD value

ac5-toggle-to-asset-for-typing.intent: Switch to BTC mode before typing an asset amount

ac5-type-asset-amount.intent: Type a BTC amount in the asset-denominated size input

ac5-assert-usd-calculations.intent: Assert asset typing updates USD-backed margin and fee calculations

ac6-set-percent.intent: Set the balance percentage input while BTC denomination is active

ac6-assert-percent-updates-size.intent: Assert percentage input updates the size while preserving BTC denomination

ac7-navigate-away.intent: Navigate away from the BTC market while BTC denomination is selected

ac7-return-btc-market.intent: Return to the BTC Perps market in the same session

ac7-wait-returned-size-input.intent: Wait for the BTC order-entry size input after returning

ac7-assert-persisted-asset.intent: Assert BTC keeps the asset denomination within the session
